UPDATE agent_jobs
               SET tokens_in = tokens_in + $2,
                   tokens_out = tokens_out + $3,
                   tokens_cache_read = tokens_cache_read + $4,
                   tokens_cache_write = tokens_cache_write + $5,
                   cost_usd = cost_usd + $6,
                   model_calls = model_calls + 1
               WHERE id = $1
